title: Time Jump: 10:15, Stop-Work Spreads on Lindgren Three

fields.narration: It is now 10:15. The stop-work sign is still on the door of the shared centrifuge room on Lindgren's third floor, and the stoppage is spreading. Dr. Tomas Eklund's cell biology run finished at 10:10, and the tubes are still inside the second centrifuge behind the closed door. Two other third-floor groups had booked the shared centrifuges for this afternoon. Both were turned away at the door. One has emailed the Biosafety Officer to ask whether it may use a centrifuge on another floor. A voicemail from Dr. Tomas Eklund is waiting at extension 5-0142: "I need a time, not a 'we'll see.' When can my people get back in? Today or tomorrow?" Down the corridor, Maya, the bacterial genetics lab manager, has had three calls in the last half hour from the student's advisor and two of her lab mates. They all want to know the same things: "Are we at risk? We were in the corridor. Should we go to the clinic too? Is she okay?" No one has sent the floor a written update yet.
worldState: Clock: 10:15. Incident LI-2026-0142 is open in the EHS portal.
The shared centrifuge room on Lindgren 3 is still under stop-work. The failed rotor is still in its centrifuge with the lid closed. No one has entered, opened it or cleaned up.
The cell biology run in the second centrifuge ended at 10:10. Those tubes are still in the room.
Two more third-floor groups have lost their afternoon centrifuge bookings. One is waiting for an email reply about using a centrifuge on another floor.
A voicemail from Dr. Tomas Eklund at ext. 5-0142 asks for a firm reopening time, today or tomorrow.
The student's advisor and two lab mates have called the bacterial genetics lab manager three times between them. They are asking about their own risk, whether to go to the clinic and how she is.
Dr. Mbeki's 10:15 appointment slot at the Occupational Health Clinic is now. The clinic closes at 17:00.
The cell biology lab still has not told its two people who were in the room whether they should be seen.
No written update has gone to anyone on the third floor.
The Halvorsen Herald's 11:30 reply deadline is still open. The @lindgren_late_nights post is still drawing replies.
Freezer ULT-L4-17 on the fourth floor is still reporting sensor offline.
fields.facilitatorNote: Pressure inject. Watch whether the BSO gives Dr. Tomas Eklund reopening criteria rather than a time, keeping the room closed until a written lift (Biosafety Plan 4). Watch whether the PI sends the corridor staff to the BSO and Occupational Health instead of guessing, and tells the advisor only what the student agrees to share (Communications Plan 6). The IO should state that the student's clinic visit comes before every schedule.
